text: The Lessee shall pay ₹ 75,000/- to the Lessor as an interest-free refundable security deposit at the time of signing this Agreement.
Security deposit: INR 1,20,000 (Rupees One Lakh Twenty Thousand only), payable on signing. The monthly rent is INR 30,000.
The Lessee has paid a deposit of fifty thousand rupees to the Lessor, receipt of which the Lessor hereby acknowledges.
The refundable deposit shall be 1.5 lakh rupees, and the monthly rent is Rs 30000 payable in advance.
The security deposit shall be equal to three months' rent, refundable on handing over vacant possession.
The deposit shall be Rs. 3,00,000 (Rupees Two Lakhs only), to be paid before possession is given.
The Lessee agrees to a minimum stay of 6 (six) months from the date of commencement, called the lock-in period, during which the Lessee cannot terminate.
Lock-in period: four months, applicable to the Lessee alone, and the Lessor shall be free to end the tenancy earlier.
Either party shall give a month's notice in writing before terminating this Lease.
The Lessee may vacate by giving 45 days' prior written notice, and the Lessor shall give the Lessee not less than 60 days' notice to vacate.
On renewal the monthly rent shall be revised upwards by 8 per cent over the last paid rent.
The rent shall be increased every year at 12% p.a. and the Lessee agrees to pay the enhanced rent from the first of the month.
The tenancy shall commence on 1st January 2027 for a period of 11 months. Rent shall be paid by the 7th of each month. Maintenance of Rs. 3,000 per month is payable to the association.
The Lessor shall refund any amount due within 30 days of vacation, and the Lessee shall give 24 hours' notice before moving heavy goods through the lift.
The Lessor shall increase the rent by ₹2,000 at the end of each year of the tenancy.
The Lessee may terminate by giving two weeks' notice, whereas the Lessor shall give two months' notice, and the Lessee shall not be liable for rent after that period.
